// diagnostic

E1269

`<field>` isn't shaped like <expected>.

What

`<field>` isn't shaped like <expected>.

Why

D-JPK-IMAGE1: an `.Oci` image's `kind`/`expose`/`env_vars`/`files`/`base` fields each have one fixed shape (a bare leading-dot value, a list of ports, a string-keyed map, a list of paths, `oci("<ref>")`) — `Image` is a closed record, so a misshapen recognized field is rejected rather than silently ignored.

Fix

Rewrite the field to match its documented shape.
